repos.description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
repos.intro: A coding-agent skill that turns your agent into a security auditor. It orchestrates isolated agents through reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, structured output, independent record verification, and target-neutral reporting.
features: Reconnaissance -- map architecture, trust boundaries, input surfaces, prior evidence, and deterministic coverage in architecture.md and cove…
Coverage-led hunting -- assign isolated hunters from ledger units, record their checks, and use coverage critics to find gaps.
Candidate validation -- give every unique candidate to a fresh verifier that tries to disprove it.
Structured output -- write confirmed , needs_validation , and rejected records to findings.json and validate them against report-schema.json…
Independent record verification -- fresh agents verify final source claims. Material replacements receive another independent verifier.
Target-neutral reporting -- derive REPORT.md , FINDINGS-DETAIL.md , and NEEDS-VALIDATION.md from the verified records and coverage ledger.
repos.description_zh: 一種用於多階段安全性稽核的 coding-agent 能力，具備可獨立驗證且機器可讀的發現結果 (findings)
repos.intro_zh: 一種能將您的 agent 轉變為安全性稽核員的 coding-agent 能力。它透過偵察 (reconnaissance)、覆蓋率導向搜尋 (coverage-led hunting)、候選驗證 (candidate validation)、結構化輸出 (structured output)、獨立紀錄驗證 (independent record verification) 以及目標中立報告 (target-neutral reporting) 來協調隔離的 agents。
features_zh: Reconnaissance -- 在 architecture.md 與 cove… 中繪製架構、信任邊界、輸入介面、先前證據以及架構中的確定性覆蓋率。
Coverage-led hunting -- 從 ledger units 分派隔離的 hunters，記錄其檢查過程，並使用 coverage critics 來找出缺口。
Candidate validation -- 將每個唯一的候選對象交給一個新的 verifier，嘗試去證偽它。
Structured output -- 將 confirmed、needs_validation 與 rejected 紀錄寫入 findings.json，並根據 report-schema.json 進行驗證…
Independent record verification -- 由新的 agents 驗證最終的來源主張。實體替換 (Material replacements) 會接受另一個獨立的 verifier。
Target-neutral reporting -- 從已驗證的紀錄與 coverage ledger 中推導出 REPORT.md、FINDINGS-DETAIL.md 與 NEEDS-VALIDATION.md。
repos.description_src: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings

AI search (GEO). How likely Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini are to cite your pages.
Local and e-commerce SEO. Google Business Profile, reviews, map pack, product pages and international sites.

結構化資料。尋找、驗證並撰寫用於豐富搜尋結果（rich results）的 Schema.org 標記。
AI 搜尋 (GEO)。評估 Google AI Overviews、AI Mode、ChatGPT、Perplexity 與 Gemini 引用您頁面的可能性。
在地與電子商務 SEO。包含 Google Business Profile、評論、地圖套件（map pack）、產品頁面與國際網站。

Present multiple interpretations — Don't pick silently when ambiguity exists
Push back when warranted — If a simpler approach exists, say so
Stop when confused — Name what's unclear and ask for clarification

提供多種解釋 — 當存在歧義時，不要默默做出選擇
在必要時提出異議 — 如果有更簡單的方法，請直說
感到困惑時停止 — 指出不明確之處並要求澄清
